supplier-qualification-process.desc: Qualify a new supplier from criteria definition through approval decision.

supply-chain-security-audit.desc: Audit software supply chain security by inventorying dependencies, scanning for vulnerabilities, verifying integrity, and testing for confusion attacks.

survival-analysis-protocol.desc: Analyze time-to-event data: prepare the dataset with censoring indicators, estimate survival curves, compare groups, fit regression models, check assumptions, and report results.

systematic-review-protocol.desc: Run a PRISMA-style systematic literature review from question definition through search, screening, data extraction, bias assessment, quantitative synthesis, and final report.

tabletop-exercise-series.desc: Design an annual series of tabletop exercises from scenario selection through complexity progression and improvement tracking.

tamper-evident-logs-foundations.desc: Decide the tamper-evident log design before writing code: model the threat, select the hash, design the record schema and canonical form, define the chain linkage, and pin the verifier specification.

tamper-evident-logs-go.desc: Build a tamper-evident log on the Go stack: design the record and canonical form, implement the gowebpki/jcs plus crypto/sha256 content hasher, a crash-safe append writer, crypto/ed25519 sign and verify, and a verifier CLI.

tamper-evident-logs-merkle-transparency.desc: Add a transparency layer over an existing chain: build a Merkle tree, generate inclusion and consistency proofs, sign checkpoints of the tree head, and anchor each head to an independent external witness.

tamper-evident-logs-python.desc: Build a tamper-evident log on the Python stack: design the record and canonical form, implement the rfc8785 plus hashlib content hasher, a crash-safe append writer, Ed25519 sign and verify, and a verifier CLI.

tamper-evident-logs.desc: Design and build a tamper-evident audit log end to end: model the threat and requirements, pick SHA-256 and an RFC 8785 canonical form, design the append-only record and hash chain, implement canonical hashing and crash-safe append writers per stack, generate and store Ed25519 keys with rotation, build a Merkle tree with inclusion and consistency proofs, sign and externally anchor checkpoints, rotate logs without breaking the chain, and ship stack-specific verifiers proven by a tamper detection test suite.

tax-optimizer-chain.desc: Multi-phase tax optimization pipeline that analyzes client tax situation, identifies deductions/credits/timing strategies, and produces prioritized recommendations with audit-risk assessment.

tax-return-preparation.desc: Prepare and file a tax return from document gathering through electronic filing.

team-onboarding.desc: Onboard a new team member: map the codebase, write documentation, scaffold their first project, and review their code.

tech-confidence-builder.desc: For people who feel left behind by technology. Start with understanding what AI actually is (no hype), learn to spot scams and stay safe online, understand what crypto is about (no pressure to buy), and get a translator for every confusing popup and error message. Zero jargon. Zero judgement. At your pace.

teenager-survival-guide.desc: Navigate parenting a teenager: communication framework, boundary setting, school monitoring, mental health awareness, and independence building.

telemedicine-visit-workflow.desc: Conduct a telemedicine visit from identity verification through visit summary.

telescope-photometry-pipeline.desc: Process photometric observations from raw images through calibration, source detection, photometry, and light curve fitting.

tenant-rights-navigator.desc: Navigate tenant rights: lease review, violation documentation, repair requests, escalation options, and move-out protection.

tenant-screening.desc: Evaluate potential tenants for a commercial or residential property. Extract applicant data, assess risk, compare against criteria, and produce a screening report.

tensile-testing-analysis.desc: Analyze tensile test data from raw stress-strain curves through yield, UTS, elongation, and modulus extraction to a mechanical testing report.

terms-of-service-creation.desc: Create terms of service for a product from scope definition through regulatory review.

terra-unita-setup.desc: Set up a new production community: plan resource allocation, optimize farm operations, and design the supply chain.

terraform-iac-aws-bootstrap.desc: Bootstrap a new AWS Terraform repo: layout, environment pattern, version pins, S3 state with locking, then fmt, validate and TFLint gates.

terraform-iac-ci-gating.desc: Gate Terraform changes in CI: fmt and validate, TFLint, Checkov, plan review, conftest policy, destroy guards, GitHub Actions plan and apply, and scheduled drift detection.

terraform-iac-security-scan.desc: Security pass over Terraform: secrets in code and state, fmt and validate, TFLint, Checkov and Trivy scans, plan review, and conftest policy on the plan.

terraform-iac-state-refactor.desc: Change what Terraform manages without recreating anything: import existing resources, move addresses with moved blocks, perform state surgery, then review the plan and protect stateful resources.

terraform-iac.desc: Lay out a Terraform repo, pick an environment pattern, pin versions, set up remote state with locking on S3, GCS, Azure or HCP Terraform, design modules and variables, handle secrets, lint and scan, test modules, import, refactor and repair state, review and policy-gate plans, guard against destroys, gate CI plan and apply, and detect drift.

test-driven-development-boundaries.desc: Design for testability at the edges: choose outside-in or inside-out, pick test doubles per collaborator, and seam time, randomness, filesystem, environment and HTTP boundaries.

test-driven-development-node.desc: Test-driven development for JavaScript and TypeScript: Jest or Vitest setup, behavior list, red-green-triangulate-refactor, c8 or istanbul coverage and StrykerJS mutation testing.

test-driven-development-python.desc: Test-driven development for Python: pytest or unittest setup, behavior list, red-green-triangulate-refactor, coverage.py branch coverage and mutmut mutation testing.

test-driven-development-red-green-refact.desc: One red-green-refactor cycle for any runner: behavior list, test names, one failing test, minimal code, triangulation into a table test, refactor under green, and an isolation audit.

test-driven-development-test-strength.desc: Check the strength of an existing test suite: isolation audit, coverage per stack, and mutation testing per stack with survivors killed by red-first tests.

test-driven-development.desc: Full test-driven development pipeline: runner setup per stack, behavior list, test names, outside-in or inside-out choice, test doubles and time, randomness, filesystem and HTTP seams, red-green-triangulate-refactor, isolation audit, coverage and mutation testing per stack.

test-suite-speed-ci.desc: Speed up test runs in GitHub Actions: baseline, persist test-tool caches, shard by recorded timing with merged coverage, select changed tests on pull requests, then prove coverage parity and report.

test-suite-speed-database.desc: Cut database fixture cost in a test suite: measure, classify database hotspots, apply per-stack transaction rollback and PostgreSQL template cloning, then prove coverage parity and report measured gains.

test-suite-speed-go.desc: Speed up a Go test suite: baseline, go test -json durations and build and init cost, hotspot plan, sleep removal, httptest boundaries, go-txdb rollback, pyramid push-down, t.Parallel and -p tuning with shuffle verification, coverage parity and a measured report.

test-suite-speed-node.desc: Speed up a Jest or Vitest suite: baseline, JSON reporter durations and transform cost, hotspot plan, fake timers, MSW handlers, rollback fixtures, pyramid push-down, worker tuning with shuffled verification, coverage parity and a measured report.

test-suite-speed-python.desc: Speed up a pytest suite: baseline, --durations and fixture cost, hotspot plan, sleep and HTTP stubs, transaction rollback fixtures, pyramid push-down, pytest-xdist with random-order verification, coverage parity and a measured report.

test-suite-speed.desc: Baseline a test suite, measure per-test durations and setup cost for Python, Node or Go, classify hotspots, remove sleeps, real network and slow database setup, rebalance the pyramid, parallelize with an order and isolation check, add CI caching, sharding and changed-test selection, then prove coverage parity and report measured gains.

thermal-analysis-interpretation.desc: Interpret thermal analysis data (DSC/TGA): preprocess curves, identify transitions and mass losses, determine kinetic parameters, quantify composition, and produce the characterization report.

thermal-analysis-protocol.desc: Analyze thermal properties of a material: prepare samples, run DSC, TGA, and DMA measurements, interpret transitions, compare against references, and produce the thermal analysis report.

thesis-research-pipeline.desc: Complete a graduate thesis from topic selection through literature gap analysis, methodology design, data collection, results writing, discussion, and defense preparation.

thick-client-pentest.desc: Penetration test of a thick client (desktop) application covering binary analysis, network interception, local storage, and update mechanism security.

thin-section-petrography.desc: Analyze a rock thin section: examine under plane and cross-polarized light, identify minerals, classify the rock, interpret petrogenesis, and produce the petrographic report.

third-party-risk-assessment.desc: Assess security risk from third-party integrations across vendor certifications, API security, data handling, access controls, and business continuity.

threat-driven-development.desc: Apply threat-driven development to a feature by decomposing it into components, identifying threats, writing security tests, and verifying mitigations.

threat-driven-test-design.desc: Design security tests driven by threat models from attack tree analysis through test case generation, automation, and coverage measurement.

threat-hunting-campaign.desc: Plan and execute a proactive threat hunting campaign from hypothesis through detection rule creation.

threat-intelligence-lifecycle.desc: Process threat intelligence from raw collection through analysis, production, and dissemination to stakeholders.

threat-modeling-session.desc: Conduct a structured threat modeling session for a system using STRIDE or LINDDUN, from architecture documentation through ranked threats to remediation assignments.

ticket-to-merged-pr-go.desc: Ticket to pull request for a Go module: clarify, write Given/When/Then criteria, verify modules and record a go test baseline, trace calls with ripgrep and gopls, plan, branch, write failing tests, implement in single-file steps, pass gofmt, go vet and golangci-lint, commit, and open the PR.

ticket-to-merged-pr-python.desc: Ticket to pull request for a Python repository: clarify, write Given/When/Then criteria, install with uv, poetry, pdm, pipenv or pip and record a pytest baseline, trace calls, plan, branch, write failing tests, implement in single-file steps, pass ruff and mypy, commit with Conventional Commits, and open the PR.

ticket-to-merged-pr-review-to-merge.desc: Carry an open pull request to a verified merge: triage CI failures, answer every review thread with evidence, choose rebase or merge to sync with the base branch, resolve conflicts, and verify the change on the base branch and deployment before closing the ticket.

ticket-to-merged-pr-ticket-analysis.desc: Turn a raw ticket into a code-ready plan without touching code: closed clarification questions, Given/When/Then criteria, repo orientation, ripgrep and LSP call tracing, a risk-rated impact list with single-file edit steps, and a test-level plan.

ticket-to-merged-pr-typescript.desc: Ticket to pull request for a Node.js or TypeScript repository: clarify, write Given/When/Then criteria, install with the pinned Node and package manager and record a Jest, Vitest, Mocha or node:test baseline, trace calls, plan, branch, write failing tests, implement in single-file steps, pass ESLint, Prettier and tsc, commit, and open the PR.

ticket-to-merged-pr.desc: Take one ticket from ambiguous text to a verified merge: closed clarification questions, Given/When/Then criteria, stack detection and per-stack test baseline (stack = python, node, go or rust), ripgrep and LSP call tracing, impact listing, branch, failing tests first, single-file edit loop, per-stack lint and typecheck, Conventional Commits, PR description, CI triage, review responses, rebase or merge sync, and post-merge verification.

time-series-decomposition.desc: Decompose a time series into interpretable components: inspect and clean the data, test stationarity, separate trend, seasonal, and residual components, detect structural breaks, forecast, and validate.

towing-prep.desc: Towing preparation: full vehicle scan for tow readiness, maintenance check for fluid levels and tire pressure, pre-drive safety with towing profile, budget for fuel cost increase (towing drops MPG 30-50%).

toxicology-risk-assessment.desc: Assess toxicological risk from hazard identification through dose-response analysis, exposure characterization, and risk quantification.

trademark-clearance-pipeline.desc: End-to-end preliminary trademark clearance for a proposed mark: searches USPTO TESS + common-law uses + international registries, applies the 13-factor DuPont likelihood-of-confusion analysis to every identified conflict, and synthesizes the results into an attorney-ready preliminary clearance opinion brief with overall risk level, per-conflict actions, and attorney-review flags. Not a substitute for a licensed trademark attorney's formal clearance opinion.

trademark-registration-process.desc: Register a trademark from clearance search through opposition monitoring.

treatment-plan-development.desc: Develop a treatment plan from diagnosis review through follow-up scheduling.

tribology-testing.desc: Test friction and wear properties: select the test configuration, set conditions, run the test, measure wear and friction, compare across materials, and produce the tribology report.

type-safety-measure-gate.desc: Measure where a repository stands (error baseline and type coverage for TypeScript or Python) and install a CI gate that stops regressions while the migration proceeds.

type-safety-python.desc: Untyped Python to checker-strict Python: baseline and coverage, grimp order, stubs, per-module mypy or pyright strict, annotation, TypedDict and Protocol, generics, Any and cast removal, pydantic at boundaries, and a CI gate.

type-safety-ts-strict-flags.desc: For a codebase already in TypeScript: baseline the errors, enable noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks and the rest of strict in stages, remove any and assertions, and gate CI on zero errors.

type-safety-typescript.desc: JavaScript to strict TypeScript: baseline and coverage, madge order, allowJs and checkJs, @types and .d.ts, per-file conversion, noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks, strict family, any removal, zod at boundaries, and a CI gate.

type-safety.desc: Full strict typing migration for TypeScript or Python: intake, baselines and coverage, leaf-first conversion order, declarations and stubs, incremental strict flags or per-module strict, eliminating any and casts, runtime validation at boundaries, and a zero-error CI gate.

user-interface-design.desc: Design a user interface from requirements through tested prototype.

ux-research-study.desc: Conduct a UX research study from question definition through actionable findings.

vacation-planner.desc: Plan the whole trip end-to-end: budget it, build the itinerary, set up pet care while you're gone, prep the house, and write out-of-office emails. From 'we should go somewhere' to packed bags.

vaccine-development-pipeline.desc: Move a vaccine candidate from antigen selection through adjuvant screening, formulation, immunogenicity assay design, animal model protocol, correlate analysis, and regulatory pre-submission.

vehicle-checkup.desc: Full vehicle diagnostic session: health scan across all modules, pre-drive safety check, then maintenance schedule review with upcoming service items.

vehicle-diagnostics-isotp-transport.desc: Bring up and verify the ISO 15765-2 transport: SocketCAN link, passive capture, vcan replay bench, kernel can-isotp, frame decoding, flow-control parameters and a Python or C client.

vehicle-diagnostics-obd2-readout.desc: Read OBD-II live data, VIN and emissions DTCs over SocketCAN and ISO-TP, scaled per SAE J1979 and decoded per SAE J2012.

vehicle-diagnostics-python-logger.desc: Build a read-only Python diagnostic logger on python-can, can-isotp and udsoncan, polling tested OBD-II PIDs and UDS DIDs behind the request guard.

vehicle-diagnostics-uds-dtc-workflow.desc: Read, decode and optionally clear UDS DTCs: guarded session control, keep-alive, 0x19 reads, status decoding, NRC handling and a confirmed 0x14 clear.

vehicle-diagnostics.desc: Full read-only vehicle diagnostics: scope and allowlist, SocketCAN and ISO-TP transport, OBD-II PIDs, VIN and DTCs, UDS session, DID and DTC reads, NRC decoding, gated clear and routine steps, DoIP, and a Python logger.

vehicle-mod.desc: Vehicle modification workflow: plan the BCM config change with risk assessment, scan vehicle health before touching anything, execute the mod, then verify with a fresh scan.

vehicle-sensor-integration-camera.desc: Bring up a V4L2, CSI or GMSL camera, lock exposure and frame rate, capture with GStreamer or C++, calibrate intrinsics in Python, C++ or ROS 2, and accept the result on held-out views.

vehicle-sensor-integration-extrinsics.desc: Characterize IMU noise with Allan deviation, calibrate camera-IMU extrinsics and time offset with Kalibr, bring up the lidar, and calibrate camera-lidar extrinsics.

vehicle-sensor-integration-gnss-rtk.desc: Check a GNSS receiver's NMEA stream, configure a u-blox receiver over UBX, add NTRIP RTK corrections, and discipline the host clock from PPS.

vehicle-sensor-integration-health.desc: Measure sensor stamp latency and monitor sensor rate, stamp age and dropouts with ROS 2 diagnostics or a Python watchdog, proven by unplug tests.

vehicle-sensor-integration-time-sync.desc: Synchronize sensor clocks with PTP and GNSS PPS through linuxptp and chrony, then measure ROS 2 stamp latency and camera event-to-timestamp offset.

vehicle-sensor-integration.desc: Integrate vehicle and robot sensors end to end: inventory, camera bring-up and exposure, intrinsic calibration per stack, IMU noise and camera-IMU calibration, lidar and radar drivers, camera-lidar extrinsics, GNSS with RTK, PTP and PPS time sync, latency measurement, dropout monitoring, and an evidence-backed acceptance report.

vehicle-simulation-carla.desc: CARLA path: server and client setup, synchronous mode, sensor rig, seed determinism, scenario authoring and library, scenario_runner execution, recorder replay and KPIs.

vehicle-simulation-gazebo-ros2.desc: Gazebo and ROS 2 path: Ackermann vehicle model, datasheet-derived sensor noise, ROS 2 bridge on sim time, seed determinism, bag replay SIL and a sim-to-real gap check.

vehicle-simulation-hil-bench.desc: Bench path: CAN log replay on a virtual bus, HIL CAN interface bring-up, a fixed-period simulated plant loop with timing measurement, and a sim-to-real gap check.

vehicle-simulation-scenario-regression.desc: Scenario regression path: author and check OpenSCENARIO files, build a seeded fault library, compute KPIs, and gate every scenario in GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.

vehicle-simulation.desc: Set up CARLA or Gazebo with ROS 2, pin seeds and prove determinism, author and check OpenSCENARIO scenarios, build a fault library, run it, compute KPIs, replay logs in SIL, run a HIL CAN bench plant loop, gate regressions in CI, and measure the sim-to-real gap.

vendor-evaluation.desc: Evaluating vendors, tools, platforms, or service providers. Build a comparison matrix, analyze reviews and feedback, assess risks of each option, and produce a recommendation report. For software purchases, contractor selection, insurance comparison, or any 'which one should I pick' decision.

vendor-security-assessment.desc: Assess a vendor's security posture from questionnaire design through response collection, control evaluation, risk rating, contract requirements, and a final assessment report.

vendor-security-questionnaire.desc: Complete or assess a vendor security questionnaire by mapping controls, drafting responses, and compiling evidence.

verified-fix.desc: The verified fix engine as a flow pipeline. Drop a bug description, get a tested fix back. Scans the codebase, identifies root cause, generates multiple fix candidates, tests each one, scores them on pass rate improvement + minimality + confidence, picks the winner, and produces a before-and-after verification proof. No Python tools needed  --  AI handles everything.

video-production-pipeline.desc: Produce a video from concept through delivery, covering scripting, shooting, editing, sound, and color grading.

voice-analyzer-chain.desc: Analyze writing samples to extract voice characteristics and generate AI-ready style guides for consistent writing assistance.

voip-telephony-pentest.desc: Authorized security assessment of VoIP and telephony infrastructure covering SIP enumeration, call interception testing, toll fraud analysis, and encryption verification.

volunteer-coordinator.desc: Coordinate volunteers for an event or organization: recruitment, scheduling, training, communication, and recognition.

vulnerability-disclosure-process.desc: Handle a vulnerability disclosure from initial report through validation, fix coordination, and public advisory.

vulnerability-management-cycle.desc: Run a vulnerability management cycle from scanning through remediation tracking and risk reduction reporting.

waf-bypass-testing.desc: Test web application firewall bypass techniques against authorized targets.

water-quality-assessment.desc: Assess water quality from sampling through reporting: design the sampling plan, collect and preserve samples, analyze parameters, compute water quality indices, check regulatory compliance, and produce the assessment report.

web-app-pentest.desc: Authorized penetration test of a web application covering injection, authentication, session management, and access control vulnerabilities.

web-application-pentest-owasp.desc: Full OWASP Top 10 penetration test of a web application, from application mapping through injection and access control testing to a categorized findings report.

web-cache-poisoning-test.desc: Test for web cache poisoning vulnerabilities in CDN and reverse proxy configurations.

web-performance-bundle-budget.desc: Analyze the JavaScript bundle for the build tool in use, split the offenders out of the initial chunk, and lock the result in with size-limit and Lighthouse CI budgets.

web-performance-cls.desc: Find the nodes and causes behind field CLS, reserve space for each source, restore back/forward cache eligibility, then verify in the field.

web-performance-inp.desc: Instrument field INP with web-vitals and Long Animation Frames attribution, reproduce the slowest interaction, break up long tasks and React render cost, then verify in the field.

web-performance-lcp.desc: Diagnose a failing LCP from field and lab data down to its dominant sub-part and fix TTFB, caching, image priority, image bytes, fonts or render-blocking resources, then verify in the field.

web-performance.desc: Full Core Web Vitals program: field and lab baselines, LCP, INP and CLS diagnosis and fixes, caching, bundle analysis and code splitting, CI performance budgets, and field verification of the result.

web-server-hardening.desc: Harden a web server by disabling unnecessary modules, setting security headers, and configuring TLS.

website-full-audit.desc: Complete website audit by every department. Engineering, security, performance, UX, accessibility, SEO, content, and analytics each run in parallel  --  then a synthesis produces a 30/60/90-day roadmap with per-role improvement ownership.

weekend-catchup.desc: Saturday morning catch-up: home status and maintenance check, vehicle health scan, workout and fitness review, weekly financial snapshot, then a weekly review wrap.

weekly-founder-ops.desc: Weekly founder operating rhythm: review company health, detect KPI anomalies, assess deal risks, and plan the week ahead.

weekly-meal-prep.desc: Plan a full week of meals: dietary needs, recipe selection, prep schedule, batch cooking strategy, and storage plan.

weekly-ops.desc: Your weekly operating system. Review last week, plan this week, prep for your meetings, check your quests, and set daily priorities. Run this every Sunday night or Monday morning.

whitepaper-to-social-threads.desc: Convert a technical whitepaper into a series of engaging social media threads, each covering one key insight with hooks, supporting evidence, and calls to action.

wifi-infrastructure-hardening.desc: Harden wireless network infrastructure by configuring encryption, segmentation, and monitoring.

will-and-estate-basics.desc: Create basic estate documents: will, power of attorney, healthcare directive, beneficiary review, and digital legacy plan.

wind-tunnel-data-analysis.desc: Analyze wind tunnel test data from raw force measurements through corrections, coefficient computation, CFD comparison, and flow feature identification to an aerodynamic report.

windows-privilege-escalation.desc: Test authorized Windows privilege escalation paths from standard user to SYSTEM or administrator.

windows-server-hardening.desc: Apply security hardening to a Windows Server following CIS benchmarks or STIG guidelines.

wireless-network-assessment.desc: Assess wireless network security covering encryption, authentication, rogue access points, client isolation, and guest segmentation.

wireless-pentest-advanced.desc: Advanced authorized wireless penetration test covering WPA2 Enterprise attacks, client-side exploitation, Bluetooth and BLE assessment, and wireless IDS evasion.

workplace-investigation.desc: Conduct a workplace investigation from complaint intake through findings and recommendations.

x-ray-diffraction-analysis.desc: Analyze X-ray diffraction data from raw diffractogram through peak identification, phase matching, Rietveld refinement, and crystallite size estimation to a final XRD report.

xml-external-entity-test.desc: Test for XXE vulnerabilities including file reading, blind out-of-band exfiltration, file upload vectors, and SSRF through XML parsing.

yara-rule-development.desc: Develop and validate YARA rules for malware detection from sample analysis through production deployment.

zero-based-budget-designer-chain.desc: Designs an optimal flow pipeline to convert income, expenses, and financial goals into a complete zero-based budget with emergency fund timeline, debt payoff strategy, and savings allocation.

zero-trust-architecture-review.desc: Review zero trust architecture implementation across identity verification, device posture, microsegmentation, continuous authorization, and legacy bypass detection.
